## Privacy policy (Datenschutzerklärung)

This website is a static site hosted on **GitHub Pages** (GitHub, Inc., 88 Colin P. Kelly Jr. Street, San Francisco, CA 94107, USA). It does not use cookies, analytics, tracking, or embedded third-party content that collects personal data.

When you visit this site, GitHub as the hosting provider automatically processes technical data such as your IP address, browser type, and time of access in server log files for the purpose of delivering and securing the website. GitHub's privacy statement is available at <https://docs.github.com/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement>. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR (legitimate interest in operating a secure website).

If you contact me by e-mail, your message and contact details are stored for the purpose of handling your request and will not be passed on to third parties.

You have the right to access, rectify, or erase your personal data, to restrict processing, to data portability, and to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. The competent supervisory authority is the Hessian Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information (Der Hessische Beauftragte für Datenschutz und Informationsfreiheit).
